person_note: The novel has sustained first-person participant narration and sustained limited-third-person sections rather than one isolated embedded voice. Quotes q00145, q00147, and q00151 corroborate the first-person strand; the authorized opening independently demonstrates a third-person Soneji section. The scholarly whole-book analysis and two explicit credible descriptions resolve this as ALTERNATING, including first-person narration by Alex Cross and Thomas Pierce alongside third-person villain or other-character chapters. Confidence is medium because only one Tier B source establishes the complete mixed structure, the Tier A evidence is opening-only, and the supplied quotes do not independently contain a diagnostic third-person passage; no credible contrary evidence was found.
